resources.string: Toki translations and subtitle files: local data only

Off by default: online translation and missing subtitle data may be requested when connected; saved caches are used when disconnected. Enable this option to force local data only. Missing translations or local engines retain the original with a notice. This controls Toki translation/caption requests, not TikTok’s own traffic; video cache export remains separate.
No cached translation or ready local engine is available, and online translation is currently unavailable. The original is retained. Check connectivity or the local-data-only setting.
No local subtitle file is available for this track, and it cannot currently be fetched online. Retry when connected; local-data-only mode prevents remote fetching.
